correctedFindings.finding: Frozen endpoint and paired active/padding strata must be nonempty before division; empty strata must not silently underweight the objective.
correctedFindings.resolution: Worker validates both endpoint strata and each paired stratum, then explicitly normalizes both measures and checks their sums against a finite summation bound.
correctedFindings.classification: Input/instrument integrity, not a quality gate.

correctedFindings.finding: Nonfinite energies/intermediates/gains or FP32 atoms must not flow into argmax or an emitted finite program.
correctedFindings.resolution: Current fitter rejects invalid reference energies and nonfinite quadratic, normal-system, constants, loss, Schur/h and gain results; FP32 atom admission is finite-checked. Frozen finite_add_array and serving add_words reject BF16 overflow.

correctedFindings.finding: The direct fallback loss must use the same explicitly retained q=P R as the relaxed objective rather than reassociating residual differences.
correctedFindings.resolution: loss() uses (prediction[j]-prediction[i])-pairResidual. Actual finite prediction responses are separately compared with independently formed native YB-YA.
correctedFindings.classification: Declared objective identity; finite nonassociativity remains explicit.

correctedFindings.finding: A Schur score alone does not expose finite disagreement with the recomputed partition loss.
correctedFindings.resolution: Each accepted split retains lossBefore, lossAfter, realizedRelaxedDecrease and schurMinusRealizedDecrease. These are observations, not new scientific gates.

correctedFindings.finding: Parent source metadata lists two whole model shards, while the four selected tensors reside in only the first authenticated shard.
correctedFindings.resolution: Publisher compares consumer parameterAssets with the selected-file subset in source order and checks reported authenticated shard and selected-tensor byte totals.

mathematicalAssessment.objective: L(D)=sum_i w_i ||(A D)_i-R_i||^2 + sum_e v_e ||(P A D)_e-q_e||^2, with explicit retained FP64 q=P R; endpoint and pair reference energies normalize their components separately, lambda=1.
mathematicalAssessment.sourceResidual: R is native discovery H1 minus actual rounded fixed-slot0 output. The unchanged fixed first writer and tokenizer/lexical initialization are reused exactly.
mathematicalAssessment.graphSystem: M=A^T W A+(P A)^T V(P A); rhs=A^T[W R+P^T V q]. Positive occupied endpoint mass makes the exact-real leaf system positive definite. Pair edges within a leaf cancel from M, but can affect a proposed split.
mathematicalAssessment.split: Appending a right-subset correction t to the current parent-column basis gives c=A^T Q t, d=t^T Q t, z=t^T[W R+P^T V q], h=z-c^T D and s=d-c^T M^-1 c. The exact-real relaxed gain is ||h||^2/s, with no extra factor of two.
mathematicalAssessment.boundary: Candidate d counts each pair weight once when exactly one endpoint belongs to the right subset, including edges internal to the old leaf. c is computed through the signed Laplacian action, preserving orientation.
mathematicalAssessment.solveAndFallback: Cholesky solves replace explicit inversion. Cancellation-dominated Schur denominators use the direct new-partition solve/loss. Nonfinite or failed finite systems are mechanics failures; no arbitrary fit quality threshold aborts evidence collection.
mathematicalAssessment.search: One deterministic greedy global split at a time, leaf DFS then feature/cut order for exact ties. Duplicate right masks keep their first occurrence. All leaf constants are jointly refit after a chosen split. This is not a globally optimal tree or an exact optimizer of finite admitted serving outputs.
mathematicalAssessment.finitePolicy: FP64 offline fitting emits FP32 atoms; unchanged serving performs slot0 then slot1, each using Python binary64 addition, FP32 RNE and BF16 RNE. Relaxed loss and actual finite loss/response remain separate.
mathematicalAssessment.numericalLimits: Floating prefix sums, Schur subtraction and solves can differ from ideal algebra. Recorded direct losses and Schur gaps expose accepted-split disagreement. The eight tests contain an ordinary Schur/direct equality witness but do not force a cancellation fallback; this is a retained mechanics coverage limitation, not a reason to add another scientific arm.

sourceServingAndIsolation.actualServingInput: Raw text passes through the unchanged qualified tokenizer/template; full-vocabulary E-only lexical rows initialize H0. The shared causal feature registers and fixed two-row prefix remain unchanged.
sourceServingAndIsolation.onlineGrammar: Two depth-at-most-four trees with at most sixteen atoms each; slot0 is frozen. Shared predicates select local FP32 writer atoms, with copy/add/rounding only. No original learned affine/gated map or native H1 is read by serving.
sourceServingAndIsolation.featureBudget: Same 155 features for the frozen discovery vocabulary and sixteen current/causal-mean lexical coordinates. Dynamic input rows and novel IDs remain owned; the novel prompt has no accuracy target.
sourceServingAndIsolation.discovery: A,B,00,10. Only these native H1 and native/control consumer ports participate in fitting or continuation selection.
sourceServingAndIsolation.transfer: 01,11 are publicly reused histories, not fresh heldout data. Their native H0/H1 and historical consumer input/output arrays are denied until the final fresh predictions are sealed.
sourceServingAndIsolation.freshPhases: Initializer on four discovery histories; candidate/endpoint/position fresh discovery outputs; candidate/endpoint/position/accepted fresh final outputs on all seven raw prompts. Discovery reproduction and selected-program output equality are checked.
sourceServingAndIsolation.rollback: Both candidate and endpoint remain available. The selected immutable directory is copied and every restored member is hashed. Transfer candidate consumers run even if discovery selects the endpoint.
sourceServingAndIsolation.guardScope: Trusted-code audit/import canaries after explicit tokenizer warmup; not an adversarial security sandbox. Parent worker imports NumPy and canonical Saturn/Torch for offline work; numerical-runtime exclusion applies to fresh serving children.
sourceServingAndIsolation.supplyingAndPaying: Teacher states, old original consumer outputs, full lexical table, fixed prefix constants and offline fitting are paid/supplied evidence. This does not establish complete encoder closure, a useful contextual response, or arbitrary-prompt zero-neural image generation.

consumerAndReuse.perUnit: One BF16 H1 [1,512,2560], FP32 RMS computation with authenticated epsilon 1e-6, BF16 norm admission/weighting, original Q [4096,2560], K/V [1024,2560] F.linear maps.
consumerAndReuse.canonicalRuntime: Byte-unchanged canonical titan.py/tensor_hash.py exported with a minimal package initializer. Each of six actual H1 inputs and retained QKV payloads is tied to content fingerprints, Frames and Acts; parameter payloads are checked before and after.
consumerAndReuse.reuseScope: Native/H0/endpoint/position outputs for six measured histories; exact fresh H1/H0 payload identities and historical program/profile bindings precede reuse. There is no new numerical replay of these controls.
consumerAndReuse.historicalCosts: Cycle103's 28 units, 84 linears, 225485783040 matrix MACs, teacher traces, lexical compilation and prior fit remain paid.
consumerAndReuse.feedbackAuthority: For each Q/K/V port, separately normalize balanced learned-row endpoint-increment error and unchanged-token response error. Average the three port sums. Strictly smaller discovery score selects candidate; ties retain endpoint. Selection is continuation policy, not terminal certification.

resources.launch: One guarded intent-first host-local Beast CUDA lease; model=None custom analysis; strict preflight; no retries; one selected parameter set.

resources.queuedJobState: Root-reported latest fleet snapshot: Beast idle with one unrelated queued latent-bridge smoke. Advisor did not query the fleet; root must recheck admission and must not cancel unrelated work.
resources.sizing: Do not hand-guess a reservation. Intent-first admission and measured whole-job telemetry remain authoritative.
resources.fitMemory: Eligible-cut QR-sum/mask/diagonal caches only, with streamed feature prefix banks. Approximately 813 MB is a conservative retained-array estimate, not whole-process RSS. Targets/residuals/QR/temporary arrays, Python/NumPy/Torch, serving children and allocator overhead are additional.
resources.gpu: Six serial B1 QKV consumers on one resident four-tensor set; no full model load. Historical cycle103 used 2403.4 MB sampled RSS and 412 MB sampled device memory, but new fitting geometry requires fresh telemetry.
resources.diskAndCollection: Existing lexical assets and original tensors remain near compute; no recompile/copy of the large lexical table into the dev checkout. Collector limits compact metadata/observations to 128 MiB and 200 files; scientific arrays remain remote.
resources.timingScope: Fit timing is distinct from worker wall and fresh serving wall. New consumer timing includes hash capture and retention. Worker wall excludes some startup verification and final report serialization; no matched speedup claim is supported.
resources.assessment: The bounded caches, tiny leaf solves and six consumer units give no static reason to expect a greater-than-15-minute run. Under-ten-minute timing is not guaranteed. Inspect progress and peaks; no automatic timeout extension or duplicate rerun is approved.
